text:
maria: quick heads-up — onboarding HF model 'code-rex-7b' hit a weird tokenizer lookup: loader picked the slow tokenizer and our special tokens disappeared in evals.

oliver: ah damn, same model had both tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json present?

maria: yes. repo has tokenizer.json (from conversion script) and tokenizer_config.json (HF original). tokenizer.json has different special token names (`<s>`,`</s>` vs `<bos>`,`<eos>`).

devon: loader priority? I thought we prefer tokenizer.json for fast tokenizers.

maria: that's the current heuristic but it only checks existence of tokenizer.json and assumes fast artifacts are there. this one had tokenizer.json but no fastmerges/vocab files — so it tried to instantiate fast tokenizer but failed silently and fell back to slow missing special tokens.

oliver: can you paste the small log?

maria: paste: ```
2026-02-18T12:02:33Z loader INFO trying tokenizer.json
2026-02-18T12:02:33Z loader WARN tokenizer.json present but fast artifacts missing: merges.bin not found
2026-02-18T12:02:33Z loader INFO falling back to slow tokenizer (tokenizer_config.json)
2026-02-18T12:02:33Z tokenizer ERROR special tokens not set: unk=None, bos=None
```

devon: ugh. so two issues: inconsistent special names between files + lookup heuristic that treats presence of tokenizer.json as authoritative even if incomplete.

alex: possible quick fix: change loader to validate required fast artifacts when tokenizer.json exists and otherwise prefer tokenizer_config.json. Or better: merge special tokens from whichever file has them.

maria: tried merging in runtime: small patch that reads both files and uses union for specials — fixed local evals. PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4321 (draft).

oliver: nice. can we add a CI rule for this? a lightweight checker in model ci that ensures either (a) tokenizer.json + fast artifacts present and specials defined, or (b) tokenizer_config.json with specials defined, and warn if mismatched.

ci-bot: new check proposal recorded: models-ci/checks/tokenizer-consistency (opt-in). See run log: https://ci.redwood.dev/4321/checks

devon: also need to document canonical precedence: specials should be canonicalized (we use `<|bos|>` internally) and conversion scripts must map HF <s>/<pad> variants. Lots of models use different names.

maria: agreed. I'll update the onboarding checklist and conversion docs. local workaround: `cp tokenizer_config.json tokenizer.json` then run `scripts/convert-fast.sh` to regenerate fast artifacts, or remove tokenizer.json so loader uses tokenizer_config.json.

oliver: good temporary steps. once PR merges can we run it against the model catalog sweep? ideally detect other models with contradictory files.

maria: scheduling a sweep job tonight. will post results tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
